rules.rule: Current line is 'Made for anywhere on your map.' Never say products are 'handmade in Colorado' or 'all made in the USA' (retired, pre-2015 claims).

Never use any word on the compliance banned list (19 words) in customer-facing copy: eco-friendly, chemical-free, toxin-free, non-toxic, detox, hypoallergenic, antibacterial, cures, heals, eczema, dermatologist-approved, clinically proven, plastic-free, zero waste, carbon negative, climate positive, guaranteed, miracle, sweatshop-free.

Use the brand vocabulary: at least one brand word per asset (offer-only lines exempt). Brand words: built, carry, recycled, mountain, travel, everyday, daily, durable, classic, adventure, trail, town, gear, pack, bag, made for, anywhere, crew, map, layer, weekend, outdoor, outdoors, collab, collaboration, wool, road, staple, heritage, community, limited edition, pocket, pockets, laptop, organization, strap, nylon, playlist, giveaway, storefront.
Write the brand name as 'Topo Designs' in running copy. Never: TopoDesigns, TOPO DESIGNS (in running copy), Topo Design.

Product names keep the family pattern: collection + item (+ size), e.g. 'Mountain Cross Bag', 'Rover Pack Classic', 'Global Briefcase'. Collabs: 'Topo Designs x Partner Item' or 'Partner x Topo Designs Item' as catalog.
Serial comma: Topo Designs uses both styles; no rule beyond clarity (observed 27 assets with, 16 without).
Prices drop trailing zeros: $26 not $26.00; keep cents only when non-zero.
Percentages and sizes as numerals: '50%', '26L', '16" laptop'.
Use spaced em dashes or ellipses for asides; no double hyphens.
Emoji in product pages and web copy: none; email body: up to 2.
Emoji per organic social caption: up to 4.
Emoji per paid ad: up to 1. All-caps words (excluding acronyms) per ad: up to 2; per social caption: up to 2; per PDP: up to 1.
Exclamation marks: ads up to 1, social up to 2, PDP up to 0, web up to 1, email body up to 1.
Reading level: grade 13 or below (Flesch-Kincaid) for ads, email, web and PDP copy of 3+ sentences.
Sentences average 24 words or fewer (ads, email, web); a spaced em dash or an emoji counts as a break.
Speak to 'you'; the brand is 'we', 'Topo' or 'Topo Designs'; the community is 'the Topo Crew'.
Collab copy names the partner, credits them as 'our friends', and says what each side brought.

rules.rule: Topo Crew is an email list, not a points program; never invent points.
Subject line 25-50 characters.
Preheader 40-90 characters and never repeats the subject.
Sender name 'Topo Designs'; reply-to a monitored address.
One primary CTA per email; button text 2-4 words in sentence case (e.g. 'Shop the sale').
Footer: address, unsubscribe, preferences, privacy, accessibility, '© 2026 Topo Designs'.
Promo emails carry offer terms in a terms line above the footer.
Transactional emails (order, shipping) lead with order facts; at most one product recommendation, below the order details.
SMS: 160 characters max including 'Reply STOP to opt out'; one link; no emoji in the first 20 characters.
Instagram: hook in the first 125 characters; 0–0 hashtags.
TikTok and Reels: gear in use, collab drops; no hashtags (observed).
Pinterest: title up to 100 chars, description up to 500 chars, no hashtags, keyword-led.
LinkedIn (S2): no emoji in first line; 1,300 characters max; up to 3 hashtags.
Comment-to-get-link posts state what the reader will receive and that it comes by DM.
Giveaways state eligibility, end date, 'not affiliated with Instagram' and link to rules.
Replies: answer the question, never argue; move order issues to DM or support; never make a claim not in claims.md.
